name: com.eldieguuu.scriptableobjectsfromsheets
description:
Generate ScriptableObject classes and assets directly from a Google Sheet inside the Unity Editor. 

▪ Builds a ScriptableObject class from a sheet, inferring a type for each column 
▪ Creates and updates assets from the sheet rows 
▪ Supports numbers, bool, string, Vector2, Vector3, Color and lists 
▪ Uses a Google service account, Editor only
